name: Doom Activation
doc: Doom Activation (the battle's own effect when a Doom countdown reaches 0, on the doomed one; the act family, Stare's kind with Angelo Search's master): one emitter per action - the director's phases: the stage darkening, a dark prim model at the target with a screen tint and a sound, then the target drawn by the effect sinking into the ground with a grey level fading out, a prim model and sprite particles turning round it going down with it; the KO at the fade's end, the stage back. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag009_doom_activation.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its state functions called from the phases, its parts spawned by it): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own - and the exe data words pointing into it (the engine's global index, the word)

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

pools.doc: run by the master, nothing spawned there
the stage darkening in and out, the sinking target (the port's)
the particle spawner and its particles (the port's)
the doom prim model and the sinking one (the port's)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: Its phases: the stage darkening, the doom model and its sound, the target sinking; the frames it waits for

parts.title: Stage darkening

parts.title: Doom model
parts.doc: The doom prim model at the target's anchor and the screen tint

parts.title: Sinking
parts.doc: The target drawn by the effect, sinking with a grey level fading out; the KO at its end; the prim model following it

parts.title: Particles
parts.doc: Sprites turning round the sinking anchor

tasks.doc: One per action (the engine's emitter, its states the port's): follows its target; sets up the director block (the target's position, the facing to it) and starts the director; the KO once the director's done flag is set; then waits for the director's end, releases the master.

The director: every tick the phase bookkeeping (a new phase spawns its tasks: 1 the stage darkening, 2 the doom model and the tint, 3 the sinking, 4 the darkening out), then its states: phase 1, its frame, phase 2, the sound, its frame, phase 3, the waits for phases 3 and 4, phase 5, done.
